players.product: InP laser chips (CW / DFB / EML) with in-house InP epitaxy for silicon-photonics and 800G / 1.6T optical modules

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results: revenue RMB 925.15 million, up 351.40% YoY; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 607.07 million, up 1,212.20%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 514.44 million (+1,033.70%); overall gross margin 80.42%. The company attributes the growth mainly to a sharp rise in data-center revenue (CW light-source products) lifting gross margin; RMB 9,222.11 ten-thousand of investment income from a private-equity fund holding (13.27% of total profit) is non-recurring.
quarterly_data.figure: revenue RMB 925.15 million (+351.40% YoY); net profit RMB 607.07 million (+1,212.20%); gross margin 80.42%

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 by market: data-center revenue RMB 77,421.66 ten-thousand, up 640.29% YoY; telecom revenue RMB 14,843.70 ten-thousand, up 48.63% (10G EML and 25G/50G PON chips in volume). Data-center products are CW and EML chips: CW 70mW / 100mW laser chips for silicon-photonics modules continued large-volume delivery and are the data-center business's main product; the 100G EML has begun volume shipments and the company says it will ramp gradually; customer validation of the 200G PAM4 EML is progressing steadily. The company says it is entering a wider range of customer supply chains and further integrating into international market supply chains.
quarterly_data.figure: data center RMB 77,421.66 ten-thousand (+640.29%); telecom RMB 14,843.70 ten-thousand (+48.63%)

quarterly_data.signal: CPO / NPO (company): building on its CW laser position it has developed several CW laser chips for co-packaged / near-packaged optics, such as 120mW, 300mW and 400mW products, and is advancing product validation and development with customers; their parameters will iterate with downstream demand.

Capacity expansion (company): in H1 2026 it kept buying wafer-process and chip-process equipment and is using the Phase II R&D and production base for optoelectronic communication semiconductor chips and devices, under construction, to expand capacity to match market growth; it says continued expansion strengthened its capacity-scale advantage. Construction in progress RMB 326.91 million at June 30, 2026 (end-2025: RMB 156.39 million); fixed assets RMB 100,537.73 ten-thousand (+49.58%); prepaid equipment (other non-current assets) RMB 37,909.92 ten-thousand.

50G optical chip industrialization project: budget RMB 75,714.41 ten-thousand, 77.19% of budget invested and under construction at June 30, 2026; the company raised the project's raised-fund investment amount in February 2026 (over-raised IPO funds plus own funds); raised-fund investment 92.44% complete, scheduled to reach ready-for-use status in December 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: budget RMB 75,714.41 ten-thousand; 77.19% invested; ready December 2026

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 R&D spend RMB 42.58 million, up 59.28%, 4.60% of revenue (H1 2025: 13.04%); 118 R&D staff. A new 'large-size process development' R&D project is at the verification-testing stage; the CW Laser for OIO and CW DFB for High Speed Transceiver projects are at the product-development stage.

Top five receivable balances at June 30, 2026 were 71.47% of receivables and contract assets (largest 30.75%, then 13.28%, 13.16%, 7.88% and 6.41%); names not disclosed. This is a share of receivables, not of sales - the half-year report gives no top-five customer sales table.

Contract liabilities, mainly customer advance payments for goods, rose to RMB 15,429.61 ten-thousand at June 30, 2026 from RMB 186.17 ten-thousand at end-2025 (+8,187.75%); the company also cites smooth collections and higher customer prepayment settlements behind H1 operating cash flow of RMB 487.67 million (+729.67%).

Overseas subsidiaries in H1 2026: Singapore trading / holding subsidiary Yuanjie Technology Pte. Ltd. revenue RMB 11,987.98 ten-thousand, net profit RMB 441.11 ten-thousand; US subsidiary YST Semiconductor Technology Corporation (optical chip production and sales) net loss RMB 1,169.97 ten-thousand; overseas assets 13.81% of total assets. The company says part of its product sales are priced in US dollars.
